reproduce.behavior: Re-records a literal playback of the preserved log; it does not rerun the timing-sensitive Enigma benchmark. The final receipt screen is held for 31 seconds so the already-generated narration can finish over visible evidence.
reproduce.workspacePathConstraint: The tape records to an absolute path under /Volumes/Code/MuleinLabs and must be adjusted if the workspace is relocated.

capturedAtBasis: MP4 filesystem modification time at capture completion

captureMethod.mode: normal-speed playback of a preserved experiment log

artifacts.kind: durable byte-for-byte copy of the original experiment log

timingContext.interpretation: The capture replays three preserved warm-run observations. It performs no fresh timing run. The values are local observations on one Apple M4 Max, not a deterministic contract or cross-platform benchmark. The final screen hold is presentation time for the existing narration, not benchmark execution.
timingContext.coldPassContext: The preserved source log also records earlier same-day cold observations near 51 Hz; the capture visibly introduces this variance note but does not present the later detail lines.

claimBoundaries: This MP4 is archived receipt playback, not a fresh execution of the benchmark.
N=1024 uses constant-filled, trivial, noise-free values and is not encrypted execution.
B=1 provides no lane-distinct batch-throughput evidence.
The clear and Metal paths agree on this 25-letter transcript in three preserved runs; this is not full HDL equivalence.
No Verilator, CXXRTL, discrete-GPU, or other native baseline is present, so the receipt establishes no speed superiority.
Compile, first-tick, steady-tick, stream, and memory figures are observations on one machine; the first tick includes JIT specialization.
Typed command echoes visibly wrap or overlap at some prompt boundaries in the VHS recording; the result lines remain legible and the durable source log is hash-identified.
